meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage, Bermudian statutory law, Privy Council as final appellate court; offshore special territory overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Bermuda constitutional relationship under the Bermuda Constitution Order 1968; no separate UK-Bermuda BIT as Bermuda is a UK Overseas Territory
US-Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) and Convention on Mutual Assistance in Tax Matters (as extended)
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (extended to Bermuda by the United Kingdom)
Network of bilateral TIEAs concluded by Bermuda with OECD member states (UK, Japan, Australia, Canada, the Netherlands and others); no comprehensive DTAA as Bermuda levies no income tax

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 (s.26 beneficial ownership register and filing duties); Beneficial Ownership (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Regulations 2018 (as amended 2020); Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 (as amended); Proceeds of Crime Act 1997; Anti-Terrorism (Financial and Other Measures) Act 2004; National Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Guidelines issued by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and the licensed AML/CFT compliance officer of the Bermuda registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the General Partner and each qualifying UBO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based Customer Due Diligence (CDD) under the Proceeds of Crime (AML/ATF) Regulations 2008 P.12A-16: obligatory screening of all partners, the General Partner, and UBOs against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Consolidated List, and EU Consolidated List; enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandated for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), high-risk jurisdictions, and for the target payment rails (Stripe and USDC cryptocurrency) a VASP counterparty due diligence check consistent with FATF Recommendation 15 and the travel rule is applied; the BMA supervises the licensed registered agent accordingly.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies - online Companies and Partnerships e-Registration portal operated by the Registry General of the Government of Bermuda (https://www.gov.bm/registry-general)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official statutory language; the registered name must be in Latin script and must include the statutory limited partnership suffix (e.g., 'L.P.' or 'Limited Partnership'); if a non-Latin script commercial name is used, a certified Romanized transliteration must be filed and the Latin-script registered name governs all statutory records.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant must file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days, annexing supporting evidence such as letters of consent from the entity with a similar name, trademark registration certificates, or explanatory memoranda; if the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may file an administrative appeal to the Minister of Finance or proceed to judicial review before the Supreme Court of Bermuda under the Administration of Justice (Prerogative Writs) Act; in practice, the fastest commercial remedy is the filing of a fresh name reservation with a distinctive element and a prior consent letter from the objecting entity.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as a substantive physical registered office located at the premises of a BMA-licensed corporate services provider; a pure virtual mailbox or a PO Box address without a licensed physical agent is not acceptable, and the requirement is satisfied for this low-risk AI/LLM API platform by engaging a licensed Bermuda registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 10-15% per annum): the Exempted Limited Partnership is unlicensed and non-regulated, but the licensed registered agent is subject to BMA oversight and may receive unannounced supervisory inspections; the BMA and the Financial Intelligence Agency may also demand UBO records and supporting documentation on an ad hoc basis.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 (as amended), sections 3-9 (formation, registration, name, registered office, general partner liability); Companies Act 1981 sections 4-6 where the corporate general partner is an exempted company; Corporate Service Provider Act 2012 for the licensed registered office provider
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Financial and Corporate Services Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Declaration of Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1) filed under section 4 of the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015; Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; capital commitments are fixed by the Partnership Agreement and no escrow or capital deposit account is required under Bermuda law
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the General Partner of the Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership to be registered under the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 approves and adopts the Limited Partnership Agreement tabled and initialed by the Chair; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the General Partner subscribes to its capital commitment under the Agreement, no statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow deposit applying; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the appointed Bermuda registered-office provider; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the authorized representative and local agent be appointed before the Registrar of Companies; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the General Partner is authorized to execute and file the Declaration of Limited Partnership, pay all fees, and open bank and payment-rail accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Financial and Corporate Services Registry (Bermuda) - Name Reservation Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed ELP name for pre-clearance through Bermuda licensed counsel; confirm absence of conflicting registered names and that the name is not undesirable in the opinion of the Minister of Finance; reserve the approved name for 28 days pending formal filing.
required_dossiers: Written authorization from proposed general partner
Covering letter from Bermuda licensed counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, counsel may file an alternative name or request reconsideration by sworn affidavit demonstrating distinguishability; a further appeal to the Minister of Finance is available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Limited Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Bermuda) - private instrument; no government filing at this stage
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and settle the Limited Partnership Agreement defining general partner authority, limited partner capital accounts, profit-sharing ratios, transfer restrictions, indemnities, and dissolution events; execute in counterparts with notarial attestation; retain a certified copy for registry submission and bank KYC.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incumbency of corporate general partner
Consent to act of registered-office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agreement conflicts with mandatory statutory provisions, execute a supplementary deed of amendment and re-attest before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration Filing of the Declaration of Limited Partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Financial and Corporate Services Registry (Bermuda) - Companies Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form ELP-1 executed by the general partner together with the certified Partnership Agreement and the consent of the resident registered-office provider; pay the statutory registration fee; obtain the Certificate of Registration and certified extract from the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Form ELP-1 Declaration of Limited Partnership
Certified copy of the Limited Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or deficiency notice, file a corrected declaration or supplemental statement within 21 days; expedited processing is available upon payment of an additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Authorized Representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Financial and Corporate Services Registry (Bermuda); licensed corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Bermuda licensed corporate service provider to maintain the registered office at a physical address in Bermuda; file notification of the appointed authorized representative; maintain the register of partners and file the annual return with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter with licensed corporate service provider
Consent to act as authorized representative
Notification of registered office and representative form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notification is rejected due to incomplete details, correct and refile; late or erroneous filings attract prescribed penalties and may be cured by a corrective statement filed with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance, Tax Election and Payment Rails Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Partner (internal governance); Bermuda Monetary Authority informational portal for payment-provider onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting of the general partner; record the pass-through tax classification in the partnership records; obtain a Certificate of Good Standing; compile the KYC/UBO package for Stripe and USDC payment rails; complete beneficial ownership filings where in scope of the Corporate Service Provider Act 2012.
required_dossiers: Partnership Agreement excerpt for bank and EMI onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or EMI rejects the KYC package, revise the UBO chart and supporting legal opinion, and resubmit under enhanced due diligence; escalate to Bermuda Monetary Authority mediation only where a regulated payment provider is involved.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - no industrial licensing board for ISIC 6201 digital software and AI services in Bermuda; informational contact: Department of ICT Policy and Innovation, Government of Bermuda
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - exempted limited partnerships do not require a trade license for offshore digital AI API services; sectoral licenses under the Digital Assets Business Act 2018 are not triggered for pure LLM inference API token sales

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Ministry of Economy and Labour, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA screening for non-physical software operations; Registration-tier review applies only if a local office lease or server hosting arrangement creates regulated waste streams
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial discharge for API-only operations; if physical premises are occupied, comply with the Clean Air Act 1991 emission thresholds, Waste Management Regulations 2013 e-waste segregation requirements, and domestic-scale effluent discharge limits under the Water and Sewerage Act 1978

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for offshore digital activities. Where a Bermuda physical office is established: fire safety certificate under the Fire and Rescue Service Act 1994; building occupancy and structural load clearance from the Building Authority under the Building Act 2014; and workplace compliance assessment under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1982.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC), Bermuda Ministry of Finance; online portal https://www.gov.bm/tax-and-duties; Bermuda Customs Department for trade and duty matters at https://www.gov.bm/customs
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Bermuda imposes no VAT, GST, corporate income tax, or withholding tax; therefore no TIN/VAT ID is issued for general corporate activities. A foreign-owned Exempted Limited Partnership must obtain a Certificate of Exempted Partnership from the Registrar of Companies. If the ELP has employees in Bermuda, it must register for Payroll Tax with the OTC using Form OTC/PT-1 and obtain an employer registration number. No VAT number can be obtained because no VAT regime exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible — A Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership is tax-transparent under Bermuda law and, for U.S. federal tax purposes, is classified as a partnership by default under the U.S. check-the-box rules provided it has at least two members and does not affirmatively elect corporate status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: For U.S. purposes, an ELP may file IRS Form 8832 to elect or confirm classification (partnership or association taxable as a corporation). Bermuda itself has no domestic income tax or entity classification election. In cross-border arrangements, OECD BEPS Action 2 hybrid mismatch rules may require defensive or adjusting elections in a host jurisdiction; such elections are governed by foreign tax law, not Bermuda law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No_VAT_GST; Bermuda levies customs duties, stamp duty, payroll tax, and foreign currency purchase tax; no value-added tax or goods and services tax applies
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not_Applicable — no VAT registration threshold exists. An importer or exporter of goods must register with the Bermuda Customs Department for a Customs Business Registration/Import-Export License, irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No VAT e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate exists in Bermuda. Customs clearance is performed through the Bermuda Single Administrative Document, accompanied by commercial invoices and supporting transport documents; no digital fiscal stamping or API-based tax reporting is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — Bermuda has no VAT or GST, so no export zero-rating mechanism or VAT refund regime exists. Exports of goods are not subject to any sales tax, VAT, or GST. Goods imported then re-exported may qualify for customs duty drawback under the Customs Tariff Act 1971, subject to compliance with Bermuda Customs procedures.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Export Permit (where the goods are regulated or subject to export controls)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback applies because no export VAT refund exists. Customs fraud or a false export declaration may result in penalties under the Customs Tariff Act 1971, including seizure of goods, monetary penalties up to three times the value of the goods, and imprisonment up to five years. Any duty drawback improperly claimed is subject to demand for repayment plus interest and penalties. Bermuda Customs, the Financial Intelligence Agency, and the Bermuda Monetary Authority may audit cross-border transactions to detect trade-based money laundering or false invoicing.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US dollar (USD). For an Exempted Limited Partnership designated as non-resident under the Exchange Control Act 1972, both current account and capital account transactions are freely permitted. Profits and capital can be remitted to partners without prior BMA approval, provided the ELP maintains its non-resident status and files accurate annual declarations. The only practical hurdles are compliance with beneficial ownership disclosure to the licensed bank, the ELP's own registered office and legal representation requirements, and the absence of any capital gains or withholding taxes in Bermuda. Full convertibility is available for USD/BMD; other currency conversions occur through the USD market.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export proceeds. Bermuda's exchange control framework permits a non-resident ELP to retain all export receipts in the original currency (including USD, EUR, or GBP) indefinitely. There is no prescribed timeline for surrender or conversion; the statutory default is immediate availability of proceeds in the receiving account. The BMA may require a declaration in the annual financial return identifying the currency composition of foreign assets, but this is not a conversion obligation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low to Medium. Bermuda does not recognise a separate EMI licence; oversea fintech payment companies (e.g., Wise, Revolut) are not authorised by the BMA to hold BMD or provide payment services from Bermuda. Such EMIs can only provide ancillary settlement in foreign currencies (USD/GBP/EUR) via partner banks, but not as a substitute for a Bermuda bank account. Using a UK or EU EMI for cross-border receivables is legally viable because the ELP's substantive treasury operations remain in Bermuda, yet the BMA's anti-money-laundering framework will require disclosure of all passporting payment rails. Crypto-native EMIs or digital asset custodians offering USDC settlement must be assessed against the Digital Asset Business Act 2018; the ELP does not need a licence for its own treasury usage, but the intermediary must hold a DABA approval if it is a Bermuda resident company.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted for Bermuda corporate entities, but physical presence waivers are bank-specific. The BMA's AML/ATF Guidance Notes require licensed banks to identify and verify all signatories, beneficial owners, and the general partner of an ELP. Most tier-1 banks accept a video interview for non-resident directors, provided original or notarised corporate documents are couriered to the bank and a local Bermuda resident director or authorised signatory is appointed where the bank's risk appetite so demands. For an exempted partnership, the general partner's authorised individual must undergo the same CDD process; a physical in-branch interview is often mandatory for the general partner of a newly formed, high-velocity digital asset platform.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Confidentiality of limited partner beneficial owners; bank cannot obtain full ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide an executed copy of the Limited Partnership Agreement and a consolidated register of limited partners to the bank under a standard confidentiality undertaking. Submit a legal opinion from Bermuda counsel confirming that the ELP qualifies as a non-resident partnership and that the general partner exercises day-to-day control, thereby limiting the bank's CDD obligation to a material 25% threshold or contractual override.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value AI API subscription and token billing creates unpredictable transaction flow inconsistent with the partnership's projected turnover.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a board-approved treasury forecast showing MT103 patterns, expected monthly transaction counts, average ticket size, and API platform analytics. Include the platform's Know-Your-Customer policy for enterprise API clients, evidence of Stripe merchant underwriting, and a copy of the platform's automated sanctions screening and transaction monitoring engine.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Treasury holds or settles USDC (cryptocurrency), triggering enhanced due diligence under BMA digital asset guidance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present the ELP's digital asset policy, a wallet custody agreement with a licensed US crypto custodian, chainalysis reports showing token provenance, and a Bermuda counsel legal opinion confirming that USDC is treated as a non-security quasi-stablecoin for treasury purposes. Also provide a deed of undertaking to maintain all USDC in segregated accounts and to convert to BMD/USD only through a regulated Bermuda deposit-taking licensee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions are routed via SWIFT MT103 from the foreign investor's bank to the ELP's Bermuda operational or escrow account. Bermuda's external payments statistical code for partnership capital injection is 'Direct Investment — Equity Capital'; the purpose code used on the wire should be 'Capital Transfer to Non-resident Partnership' or the equivalent BOP code recognized by the receiving bank. For an ELP designated as non-resident, no BMA prior approval is required before receipt. Verification pack: signed subscription agreement, limited partner identification, source-of-funds statement, proof of corporate authorisation, and the partnership's bank instruction letter.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for trade settlements and operational disbursements is the SWIFT MT103 wire transfer channel via the ELP's correspondent US dollar clearing account. For physical infrastructure acquisitions or enterprise licences that require documented trade terms, a Commercial Letter of Credit issued by a Bermuda bank and advised through a London or New York confirming bank is permissible. Recurring API vendor payments and AI cloud costs are executed via MT103 in USD, while downstream revenue collection utilises Stripe (ACH/SWIFT rails) and USDC stablecoin transfers through authorised digital asset custodians. All outbound payments must be screened against OFAC and BMA sanctions lists; no separate exchange control license is needed for non-resident ELPs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/BMD forwards traded with a Bermuda licensed bank or its overseas branch
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on non-convertible emerging market currencies (e.g., CNY, INR) for hedging API fee receipts from Asia Pacific markets
Cross-currency swaps between USD and GBP/EUR for settling UK/EU vendor invoices
FX vanilla options for protecting dividend distributions to non-resident limited partners

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration for Exempted Limited Partnership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days of the anniversary date of registration of the exempted limited partnership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fee of USD 250 per month or part month; continued default beyond 90 days may lead to administrative strike-off of the ELP from the Bermuda exempted partnerships register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Government of Bermuda (Bermuda Registrar of Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable by 31 January of each calendar year for existing exempted partnerships, or within 60 days of the anniversary date for newly registered partnerships
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If unpaid by the due date, the Registrar may impose a late charge of USD 500; if the fee remains unpaid for six months, the Registrar may strike the ELP off the register and dissolve the partnership under Bermuda law.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporate Affairs (Economic Substance Unit), Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the ELP financial year if the partnership carries on a relevant activity; for a calendar-year partnership, due by June 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of USD 2,500 for failure to file, plus USD 250 per day during continued non-compliance; prolonged default may result in a determination that the partnership fails the economic substance test, with additional financial penalties and mandatory information disclosures to the Bermuda Competent Authority.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit requirement under the Bermuda Exempted Partnerships Act 2015 for an ordinary exempted limited partnership. An audit becomes mandatory only when the ELP is licensed or supervised under regulated financial legislation (e.g., insurance, banking, or investment funds legislation) or when the partnership agreement expressly requires an audit and a limited partner holding at least 10% of partnership capital requests one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Bermuda statutory accounting framework is prescribed for exempted limited partnerships. IFRS is generally recommended for consolidated and private equity partnerships; US GAAP is commonly used where US limited partners are present. The partnership agreement may also designate UK GAAP or an equivalent local GAAP for reporting purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda maintains a central Beneficial Ownership Register for legal persons, but exempted limited partnerships are transparent partnerships and are not required to make an annual UBO filing unless the Registrar issues a specific notice requiring confirmation. In ordinary circumstances, the general partner must keep a current register of partners and beneficial owners at the registered office and must update that register within 30 days of any transfer of a partnership interest, change of partner particulars, or change of beneficial ownership. If the Registrar publishes a Beneficial Ownership Return notice, the ELP must confirm the registered details within the deadline stated in that notice.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of the General Partner

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for standard Bermuda-resident entities (no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax); 15% under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 for constituent entities of in-scope multinational enterprise groups with consolidated revenue ≥ €750M (GloBE-aligned)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday or CIT exemption certificate for AI/LLM API platforms. Incentives are limited to: (i) complete CIT absence below the €750M large-MNE threshold; (ii) for in-scope CIT groups, the substance-based income exclusion (payroll and tangible-asset carve-out) and the Economic Transition Adjustment; (iii) payroll tax, not profit tax, applies to employer remuneration. CIT losses for in-scope groups carry forward indefinitely under the GloBE-aligned regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (CIT Act 2023); filed via the Bermuda Tax Administration e-filing portal of the Office of the Tax Commissioner
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 months after the end of the relevant CIT period (first return for a newly in-scope group due within 18 months of the end of the transition period)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the ELP, CIT constituent entity code, jurisdiction of incorporation, and fiscal year-end
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the ELP's Bermuda Registrar number and ultimate parent entity details; non-resident partners are not separately registered for CIT unless the ELP itself is in scope

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of GloBE income / loss before adjustments, including the Economic Transition Adjustment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a tax-transparent ELP, include the partnership's full Bermuda-source and foreign-source income as computed under Pillar Two rules; disclose inter-partner allocations

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance-based income exclusion based on eligible payroll costs and tangible assets in Bermuda
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Bermuda payroll and Bermuda tangible assets of the ELP; exclude outsourced UK AI development headcount

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable credits, Qualifying Domestic Minimum Top-up calculation, and net CIT due at 15%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a detailed schedule of any foreign tax credits only if a DTA/TIEA mechanism exists; otherwise zero allocation to non-resident partners

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing civil penalty up to BMD 10,000 plus BMD 100 per day of continuation (maximum BMD 100,000); interest on unpaid CIT at the statutory daily rate; criminal penalties for deliberately false returns of up to BMD 50,000 and/or imprisonment

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR); filed through the Bermuda Registrar of Companies online registry (e-Registry)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the ELP's fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity classification: Intellectual Property Business, Headquarters Business, or Pure Equity Holding Entity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an AI LLM API platform licensing model weights and SDKs, select 'Intellectual Property Business' and list the physical Bermuda place of business

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities (CIGAs) performed in Bermuda: strategic IP management, R&D oversight, licensing negotiation, exploitation and protection of intangibles
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the number of senior managers physically present in Bermuda; do not claim CIGAs performed by UK directors without a Bermuda attendance record

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance resources: full-time employees, premises, and annual operating expenditure in Bermuda
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide headcount and payroll data for Bermuda staff only; a shell ELP with zero employees must file a nil/equity-holding declaration and risks strike-off

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Immediate penalty of BMD 10,000 for non-filing; continuing penalty of BMD 10,000 per month; Registrar may strike off the ELP and refer officers for criminal prosecution

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Payroll Tax Return (Payroll Tax Act 1995); employer filing via the Bermuda Payroll Tax Office online portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross remuneration paid to Bermuda-resident employees and expatriates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil remuneration for non-resident partners or remote UK contractors; payments to UK directors for Bermuda board services must be appraised for Bermuda payroll tax exposure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions: statutory pension contributions, medical insurance, and exempt gratuities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain payroll records for all P11D-equivalent benefits in Bermuda; UK pension contributions are not automatically deductible

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable payroll and payroll tax due at the applicable progressive employer rate (approx. 4.75%–10.25%)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If payroll is nil, file a nil return; failure to file a nil return attracts late-filing penalties

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Surcharge of 5%–10% on late paid tax; monthly interest at 1%; fines up to BMD 10,000 and imprisonment for false payroll declarations

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends, partnership distributions, interest, royalties, management fees, or any profit repatriation by an Exempted Limited Partnership
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda has no comprehensive double taxation agreement with the United Kingdom; relief is obtained unilaterally. Administrative protocol: (i) file a distribution resolution with the ELP records; (ii) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence from the Bermuda Registrar / Office of the Tax Commissioner stating the ELP is resident in Bermuda for ESR purposes; (iii) submit the TRC, audited ELP financial statements, and a partner-by-partner allocation schedule to UK HMRC when claiming double taxation relief for any Bermuda CIT actually paid by an in-scope ELP; (iv) UK-resident partners remain taxable in the UK on their partnership share, and HMRC will apply UK CFC/transparency rules
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate: 0% for royalties and interest paid to or from Bermuda, including AI API licensing fees, model-weight license fees, and intercompany debt interest. UK-source patent royalties or crypto-payment processing interest paid by a UK payer may trigger UK withholding tax at 20% unless an exemption or UK-DTA procedure applies; Bermuda's zero-WHT regime does not override UK domestic sourcing rules

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: For CIT-in-scope ELPs: Master File required where the multinational group has consolidated revenue ≥ €750M (approx. BMD 750M); Local File required where Bermuda ELP annual turnover exceeds BMD 25M or where related-party transactions with UK or other affiliates exceed BMD 25M per annum. Zero-CIT ELPs are not subject to Bermuda CIT transfer-pricing documentation, but contemporaneous pricing evidence (including OpenAI-API benchmarking) should be maintained for UK CFC and OECD substance defense
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Act 2018 applies to all resident ELPs. An AI LLM API platform engaged in licensing, leasing, or otherwise exploiting IP (model weights, source code, SDKs, API algorithms) is almost certainly classified as an 'Intellectual Property Business' and must demonstrate: (i) core income-generating activities performed by qualified full-time employees physically in Bermuda; (ii) adequate physical premises and operating expenditure proportionate to UK-conducted R&D; (iii) active board/partner management in Bermuda. A passive ELP that only collects API subscription revenue without Bermuda substance is a shell entity and faces ESR penalties and possible strike-off

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: ELP licenses AI model weights and API access to UK affiliates while performing zero Bermuda CIGAs: no Bermuda office, employees, or R&D supervision; UK directors negotiate all contracts and API pricing; ESR filed falsely as a 'Pure Equity Holding Entity'
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 10,000 per month under ESR Act 2018; simultaneous CIT assessment if the ELP is part of a €750M+ group; Registrar-initiated strike-off and dissolution; HMRC may recharacterize the ELP as UK-resident under the UK deemed-domicile and CFC 'gateway' rules
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the corporate general partner are personally liable for knowingly submitting false ESR declarations; civil restitution of tax savings; 7-year UK tax-geared penalties; travel bans against senior officers under HMRC worldwide disclosure procedures

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: UK-resident individual partners receive AI API profits distributed from the Bermuda ELP without declaring partnership income on UK SA100 returns; artificial royalty payments to a UK IP-holding LP structured solely to exploit 0% Bermuda WHT; no substance, no transfer-pricing file, and no UK CFC disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: HMRC assessments extending back up to 20 years for deliberate concealment; penalties up to 200% of the tax evaded under FA 2007 Schedule 24; daily penalties for failure to provide CFC information; charging orders and freezing orders on UK real estate and bank accounts; criminal prosecution under FA 2000 s.144 with imprisonment up to 7 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several partner liability for the ELP's undisclosed profits; general partner personal liability for taxes and interest; directors can receive personal penalty determinations up to £100,000; HMRC 'naming and shaming' publication and UK immigration exit bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: ELP collects API subscription fees in USDC via cryptocurrency rails without AML/KYC control; failure to file beneficial ownership information under the Beneficial Ownership (Exempted Partnerships) Act 2020; anonymous token-holder distributions treated as partnership capital returns to conceal revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) fines of up to BMD 250,000 per contravention; Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 confiscation orders of the full value of laundered proceeds; ELP struck off and the corporate general partner disqualified; criminal AML penalties of up to 15 years' imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owner and senior managing officer must be registered with BMA and face personal confiscation; directors who signed false beneficial ownership returns are subject to civil restitution, travel bans, and immediate arrest upon re-entry to Bermuda

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late / Fraudulent Filing of Tax Returns
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file ESR, payroll tax, or CIT returns even on zero liability; knowingly understating partner payroll vs profits; presenting stale or fabricated bank statements to the Bermuda Registrar to maintain good standing for UK EMI banking
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda Registrar fines BMD 10,000 plus BMD 100–500 daily penalty per return; loss of tax-residence certificate; dissolution of the ELP; immediate denial of the ELP's ability to onboard with Stripe or UK alternative banking rails; UK Companies Act director disqualification for cross-border filing fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for all unpaid Bermudian payroll tax and surcharges; fraudulent trading claims by liquidators with joint and several principal liability; summary criminal conviction with imprisonment up to 6 months; permanent UK director disqualification orders
